newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu to return to Kinshasa this week - aides.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to return to Kinshasa this week - aides.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko, due to leave a hospital in Monaco on Thursday after cancer treatment, will return to his country's capital, Kinshasa, by the end of the week, his press service said on Wednesday.
The announcement made clear Mobutu intended to lead an effort to quell a fast spreading revolt in eastern Zaire against his 32-year rule.

Mobutu was admitted to Princess Grace hospital in Monte Carlo on Sunday for "additional treatment" after he had spent a month at his French Riviera villa convalescing from prostate cancer surgery last August.

His previously announced plans to return home were thwarted by medical problems while the rebels led by Laurent Kabila captured the third-largest city of Kisangani and vowed to march on to Kinshasa and topple the ailing president.

The political situation in the capital has been complicated by an attempt by opponents in parliament to oust Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo, appointed by Mobutu, deepening the sense of political crisis.
Aides said Mobutu would hold a photo session at his villa on Thursday after leaving hospital in a clear attempt to quell reports that he is seriously ill.
